name: Margin
welcome: A place for your next revision.
description: Open a folder for manuscripts, tracked changes and conversations in the margin.
desktop: File access requires the desktop app. Run pnpm tauri dev to open Margin.
empty: Create or import a manuscript to start reviewing.
conflict: This manuscript has a newer revision. Reopen it after preserving your draft.
pending: Wait for the manuscript to finish saving before switching.

ai.title: AI reviewer
ai.description: Authorize one external AI client for this manuscript. It can propose edits and join comments; you control manuscript changes.
ai.name: Reviewer name
ai.credentialHint: Add this HTTP MCP configuration to your chosen AI client and keep Margin open. Treat the token as a credential. Disconnecting or switching manuscripts revokes it.
ai.stale: Based on an older manuscript. Ask the AI to submit a new proposal against the current version.
ai.truncated: Preview truncated. Applying uses the complete proposal.
